summary: Short kerb at a busy junction mouth, no stopping, homes 10 m away.
reasons: Junction with island, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 10-17 m away on the section's side, apartments within 31 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the junction corner beside a slip lane and island; no parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Junction of two through streets; steady turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign; no parking convention.

sun_shade: Partly shaded by trees on the north side; open to the east.

best_section.where: south kerb just east of the junction, by the roundabout-style island
